notes: CBS code 120010 = 'Consumer Price Index - General' from the dedicated apis.cbs.gov.il/index/data/price API (distinct from the general series/* API, whose catalog is unreliable — see CLAUDE.md). Both sides report a year-over-year inflation rate (CBS percentYear vs Eurostat RCH_A_AVG), so the two are genuinely comparable despite different index base years.
CBS code 40010 = 'Prices of Dwellings' from the same dedicated price-index API. Both sides use annual rate of change, so directly comparable across different index base years.

A third CBS access path: apis.cbs.gov.il/SDMX/DATA/IMF/ECOFIN_POP/1, an IMF-standard SDMX dataflow whose response header identifies the sender as 'Israeli Central Bureau of Statistics' — this is CBS's own population data reported via a standardized schema (INDICATOR=LP_PE_NUM, REF_AREA=IL), not a third-party estimate. Verified plausible: 5.05M (1991) rising to 10.25M (2026), matching known Israeli demographic history. Both sides are a plain population count (Eurostat unit=Number, CBS UNIT_MULT=3 i.e. thousands), directly comparable.
